questions.question: What was the theme of the International Yoga Day 2019 ?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**"Yoga for Climate Action".**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The fifth edition of International** Yoga Day (IYD-2019) **is celebrated across the country and abroad on 21st June with the theme** ‘Yoga for Climate Action’.**
 
• The aim of the IYD is to raise awareness worldwide of the many benefits of practicing yoga.
 
• **Yoga** is a practice that **originated** in India.
 
• The word yoga is a **Sanskrit** word that means to unite or to join.
 
• Yoga symbolizes the unification of the body and consciousness.
 
• Yoga has 84 classical asanas such as **Tadasana**, **Trikonasana**, **Bhajangasana**, etc.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 'Bhagavad Gita' makes two important statements: **“yoga - sthah kuru karmaani”** (Do your duty with a yoga approach) and** “samatvam yoga uchyate” **(balance is the essence of yoga).
 
• Yoga is an approach to life that focuses on physical balance, mental equilibrium, and working towards a harmonious synthesis of diverse elements including the protection of the environment.
 
• The first Yoga Day celebration was held at Raj Path in New Delhi. PM Modi and other dignitaries performed around 21 yoga asanas, and created two Guinness World Records. The first record was for being the world’s largest yoga class with 35,985 people and the second one was for having the maximum number of participating nationalities, that is 84.

Central Vigilance Commission observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2022 with which of the following themes?

options.text: Corruption free India for a developed Nation
Independent India @ 75: Self Reliance with Integrity

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Corruption free India for a developed Nation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2022 with the theme **"Corruption free India for a developed Nation"**.

• The Vigilance Awareness Week was observed from **31st October to 6th November 2022**.

• The observance of this week commenced with the taking of the **Integrity Pledge** by public servants and other stakeholders.

• The aim of Vigilance Awareness Week is to **raise public awareness about the perils of corruption and promote integrity in public life**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)**

• The CVC is an apex Indian governmental body created in 1964 to address governmental corruption.

• It was set up on the recommendations of the Committee on Prevention of Corruption, headed by Shri K. Santhanam.

• The Commission is tasked with monitoring all vigilance activities under the Central Government and advising various authorities in central government organizations in planning, executing, reviewing, and reforming their vigilance work.

• **Vigilance Awareness Week**

• Vigilance Awareness Week is observed every year during the week in which the birthday of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel (31st October) falls.

• The week is marked by various activities such as debates, lectures, and awareness campaigns to promote vigilance and integrity.

• The Integrity Pledge is a key component of the week, encouraging people to adhere to ethical conduct and fight against corruption.

• **Integrity Pledge**

• The Integrity Pledge is an oath taken by individuals to uphold and promote ethical practices and fight corruption.

• It is aimed at creating a corruption-free environment in all spheres of life, including public and private sectors.

• The pledge is taken by employees of government organizations, PSUs, and other stakeholders.

questions.question: When was the 120th birth anniversary of Shaheed Udham Singh celebrated in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**26 December 2019.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• On **26 December 2019**, the 120th birth anniversary of Shaheed Udham Singh celebrated in India.
 
• **Shaheed Udham Singh** was an Indian freedom fighter belonging to **Ghadar Party**. He was born in **1899** in the **Sangrur district of Punjab.**
 
• Shaheed Udham Singh is known for his assassination of **Michael O'Dwyer** in London, on 13 March 1940. **Michael O'Dwyer** was responsible for the** Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar in 1919**. As revenge, he was killed by** Udham Singh**.
 
• **Michael O'Dwyer** was an Irish Indian Civil Service officer and during 1913 and 1919 he was the former **lieutenant governor of Punjab in British India**.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• On** 26 November 2020**, we celebrated **Constitution day.**
 
• On** 28 September 2020**, we celebrated the 113th birth anniversary of birth **Shaheed Bhagat Singh.**

questions.question: When was the National Hydrogen Mission (NHM) launched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**15 August 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On August 15, 2021**, Honorable Prime Minister launched,** National Hydrogen Mission.**
 
• This is the first scientific assignment in India to address all characteristics of **value chain of hydrogen-based mobility**. 
 
• With this mission, India is all set to goal the **renewable energy sector** and push to harness the** power of hydrogen energy. **
 
• This budget allotted **1500 INR crore** for the development of renewable energy including hydrogen.
 
• Hydrogen energy is predicted to reduce carbon emissions that are set to jump by **1.5 billion tons in 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Hydrogen Mission will **center on the generation of hydrogen** from green power resources and link **India's growing renewable capacity with the hydrogen economy.**
 
• Hydrogen is a clean alternative to methane, also called as** natural gas.**
 
• It is the most abundant chemical element, approximate to **contribute 75% of the mass of the universe.**
 
• Here on earth, large numbers of hydrogen atoms are **contained in water, plants, animals and, of course, humans.**​

questions.question: In which of the following years was the first radio show broadcast in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1923.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first **radio broadcast in India was on **June 23, 1923,** by the **Radio Club of Bombay**.
 
• It was a** test transmission**, and the first regular broadcasting began on** July 23, 1927**, from the same club.
 
• The broadcasting was initially done in the evenings for** 30 minutes,** and the programs were mainly music concerts and talks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **Radio broadcasting** is the process of sending** audio across radio waves** to radio receivers owned by members of the general public, occasionally along with pertinent metadata.
 
• There are **now four forms** of radio broadcasting in use:
 
 
• **AM**: Electromagnetic radio waves are all around us but are invisible to the naked eye. 
 
• **FM:** The term FM refers to frequency modulation. 
 
• **DAB:** Digital Audio Broadcasting, or DAB, is an acronym. 
 
• **Internet radio**: When a radio station streams its content online, it's known as internet radio.

questions.question: In April 2018, the United Nations General Assembly declared 3rd June as _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. __**World Bicycle day.**__

 
• United Nations has declared **June 3rd as International World Bicycle Day**, **by adopting a resolution on April 12th 2018, during the 72nd Regular Session of the UN General Assembly, in New York City.**
 
• **To acknowledge the “uniqueness, longevity, and versatility” of the bicycle.**
 
• Encourages stakeholders to emphasize and advance the use of the bicycle as a means of fostering sustainable development, strengthening education, including physical education, for children and young people, promoting health, preventing disease, promoting tolerance, mutual understanding and respect and facilitating social inclusion and a culture of peace;
